annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (C/AISC - Artificial Intelligence Standards Committee)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets governance activities organizations developing or using AI should follow for responsible, ethical, accountable AI.
Provides governance Principles for the governing body to consider and prioritize.
Provides Processes to implement the Principles.
Includes case studies on AI applications, including resolving tensions between Principles.
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA catalogue page for IEEE 2863-2026, an approved draft recommended practice on organizational governance of AI. It sets governance principles and processes for governing bodies of organizations developing or using AI, with case studies on resolving tensions between principles.
annotation.title_clean: IEEE 2863-2026 IEEE Approved Draft Recommended Practice for Organizational Governance of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: IEEE 2863-2026 IEEE Approved Draft Recommended Practice for Organizational Governance of Artificial Intelligence
